column4: The market is driven by us in terms of outsourcing and only 30% of that market is today outsourced. [#1486](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-1486)
60% of new contracts are outsourcing the market. [#1489](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-1489)
So these are the main drivers of the outsourcing. [#2520](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-2520)
So in the average of the last 10 years, 1/3 -- about 1/3 of the growth for the new wins came in from outsourcing. [#2517](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-2517)

So that means that people that will outsource first time with us and what is a gain of market share, so customers that we'll take from the competition. [#922](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-922)

And about 1/3 of everything that we sell between all the segments is coming by outsourcing, which is -- which gives on average between 3% to 4% of organic growth only driven by that. [#2521](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-2521)
When you look at the numbers of new contracts we signed coming from outsourcing, it is more than half of them. [#1488](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-1488)

There are some opportunities, nevertheless, most of the opportunities as linked to the markets themselves that are growing and that can be outsourced a lot more. [#1523](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-1523)
Growing the market by outsourcing is something that we always did. [#2516](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-2516)

So a huge market, of which EUR 2 billion approximately belongs to the outsourced services for workwear and another EUR 1.2 billion for other services around facility, washroom, et cetera. [#1304](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-1304)

We're delivering the major player in this market as, of course, [ Korean, MES, Elsenbast, ] in France, still outsourcing only at 21% compared to the rest of Europe, where the outsourcing rate is for sure. [#1096](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-1096)

So if you are in a situation where you push for outsourcing, so in LatAm or Eastern Europe in [ Workwear], you have a majority of contracts signed with people that will outsource with us first time. [#925](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-925)
And we have only 1/4 of the market outsourced today. [#1480](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-1480)
